div.div: Dashed arrows into and out of the Outbox bar are domain events (PRD section 11 'Emits / consumes'). Arrows from a module into the bar are emits; arrows from the bar go to subscribers. Module names follow the PRD module table plus Media (M3-DESIGN D29); milestones follow ROADMAP. The solid Deeds → Identity arrow is a service.py call; Media and Feed also read deeds.service and identity.service, Feed reads media.service, and only media/router.py reads feed.service (D30). Scoring (M4) subscribers of the other deeds events are named in M2-DESIGN section 4, not drawn here.
